parsed.explanation: No presentation offence and a strong anti-discrimination Penal Code, but paper protections are shown not operating: institutions are documented as failing to investigate anti-trans violence (2020 judge report, impunity findings), and the 2001 morals provision is used as a police pretext to harass and detain trans women, with documented rape, assault and extortion. Custody is a tier-1 exposure — trans women held in men's prisons, forced hair-cutting, segregation, guard-complicit sexual violence with prosecutorial inaction — universal for any outed visitor who is detained. Border and document treatment are unresolved (open question, not exposure). Recent signals (2021 rights report listing violence and lack of accountability; 2022 activist killing) show the pattern persists. Killing tallies lack denominators and carry no rate weight. Civil society visibility (pride, candidacies) and strong statutory text mitigate only slightly.
